text.title: Single Channel Bet Selector — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the channel-bet record: a dated rubric with its storage location, the ICP sample it was read from (at least 5 paying customers or 50 qualified conversations), 3 to 6 tactic-level candidates from the Traction taxonomy each scored 1 to 5 on founder_fit, icp_density (with the observed-of-sample count) and early_traction with the total and whether it clears 12 of 15 with every axis at 3 or more, an outcome of bet or no_bet, the single 90-day bet with its weekly unit, week-4 and week-8 checkpoints and a kill criterion written on the selection day, a no-bet route when nothing clears, and a parking lot holding every other candidate with its score. Validator at scripts/validate-single-channel-bet-selector.py enforces it, including the score sums, the threshold and floor, the 90-day window, the parking-lot coverage and the kill criterion date.

required.field: the day the rubric was scored and the bet chosen (r-written-rubric-single-page)
where the dated single-page rubric lives: a repository path or a dated document URL (r-written-rubric-single-page)
false; a channel already producing revenue is not re-picked (06-decision-tree)
`paying_customers` and `qualified_conversations`; at least 5 customers or 50 conversations (r-icp-density-cites-sample)

3 to 6, each `channel` at tactic level, `taxonomy_channel` from Traction's 19, `founder_fit`, `icp_density` with `icp_density_sample` {`observed`, `of`} or null (then icp_density is 1), `early_traction` with `unsolicited_inbound_count`, `total` = the three scores, `clears_bar` = total at least 12 and every axis at least 3 (r-candidate-set-from-named-list, r-three-axis-scoring, r-icp-density-cites-sample, r-threshold-12-of-15-and-per-axis-floor)
bet when a candidate clears the bar, otherwise no_bet (r-threshold-12-of-15-and-per-axis-floor)

null on no_bet; otherwise `channel` (a clearing candidate), `start_date`, `end_date` 90 days later, `weekly_unit` {`count`, `unit`}, `checkpoints[]` at week 4 and week 8 each with `metric` and `expected`, `kill_criterion` {`week` 12, `written_on` = selected_on, `conditions[]` {`metric`, `operator`, `value`}, `action` rerun_rubric_with_result_as_early_traction, `revised` false} (r-one-channel-parking-lot, r-weekly-unit-and-checkpoints, r-precommitted-kill-criterion)
null on bet; otherwise `route` discovery or instrument_highest_scorer and `highest_scorer` (r-threshold-12-of-15-and-per-axis-floor)
`channels[]` with every non-chosen candidate and its `total`; `active_work_allowed` false (r-one-channel-parking-lot)

forbidden.pattern: fewer than 3 or more than 6 candidates, or a `channel` written at category level (social, outbound, content) rather than the weekly tactic — fm-01-rubric-ratifies-a-prior-choice
a fourth axis, a weight on any axis, a score outside 1 to 5, or a `total` that is not the sum of the three (r-three-axis-scoring)
`icp_density` above 1 with `icp_density_sample` null, or an `observed` count larger than the sample (r-icp-density-cites-sample)
a bet on a candidate with `total` below 12 or any axis below 3, or `outcome` bet with no candidate clearing the bar — fm-02-high-total-low-axis
a candidate missing from `parking_lot.channels`, or `active_work_allowed` true — fm-03-parking-lot-leakage
no `weekly_unit`, checkpoints at weeks other than 4 and 8, or a checkpoint without a numeric `expected` — fm-04-ninety-days-without-telemetry
`kill_criterion.written_on` later than `selected_on`, `revised` true, a non-numeric condition, or an `action` other than re-running the rubric — fm-05-kill-criterion-moved-at-week-11
`working_channel_exists` true, or an `end_date` that is not 90 days after `start_date` — fm-06-re-picking-a-working-channel

example.note: Four tactic-level candidates from the Traction taxonomy; 11 paying customers clear the sample threshold; LinkedIn founder posts scores 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 with every axis at 3 or more and 7 of 11 customers observed there; the bet runs exactly 90 days with 3 posts a week, checkpoints at weeks 4 and 8, and a kill criterion written on the selection day; the three other candidates sit in the parking lot with their totals.

A rubric that lives in Slack; 2 customers and 9 conversations below both sample thresholds; two candidates, one written as the category "social" with icp_density 5 and no sample; a bet on it despite early_traction 2; a 122-day window with no countable weekly unit; one checkpoint at week 12; a kill criterion written eleven weeks in, already revised, with a non-rerun action; an empty parking lot with active work allowed.

list.item: `selected_on` and `rubric_location` are filled; `working_channel_exists` is false; `icp_sample` has at least 5 paying customers or 50 qualified conversations.

3 to 6 candidates at tactic level from the taxonomy; each `total` is founder_fit + icp_density + early_traction; `clears_bar` is true only at 12 or more with every axis at 3 or more; a null `icp_density_sample` scores 1.
`outcome` bet has a `bet` on a clearing candidate and `no_bet_route` null; `outcome` no_bet has `bet` null and a route with the highest scorer.
`bet.end_date` is 90 days after `start_date`; the weekly unit is countable; checkpoints at weeks 4 and 8 carry numbers.
`kill_criterion.written_on` equals `selected_on`, conditions are numeric, `action` re-runs the rubric, `revised` is false.
Every non-chosen candidate is in `parking_lot.channels` with its total; `active_work_allowed` is false.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (score sums, threshold and floor, bet on a clearing candidate, 90-day window, checkpoint weeks, kill criterion date, parking-lot coverage, highest scorer on no bet).
The same schema as a standalone file.
